text: {"lessons":["My account value moved both up and down while I made no trades; I shouldn’t treat a short run of results as evidence that I can predict next month’s prices.","I should judge each holding by its prospects from today, not cling to it just to avoid admitting a purchase was a mistake.","Checking only a few times a year suits my habits, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash fit my plan and make deliberate decisions when needed."]}
